text_en: To the leader: according to The Gittith. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官。调寄"加特"。

text_en: O Lord , our Sovereign, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.
text_cn: 上主，我们的主！你的名号在普世何其美妙！ 你的尊荣在天上彰显光耀。

text_en: Out of the mouths of babes and infants you have founded a bulwark because of your foes, to silence the enemy and the avenger.
text_cn: 由赤子乳儿的口中，你取得完美的赞颂； 为使恨你的人受辱，为使仇敌有口无用。

text_en: When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you have established;
text_cn: 当我仰观你手指创造的穹苍， 和你在天上布置的星辰月亮，

text_en: what are human beings that you are mindful of them, mortals that you care for them?
text_cn: 世人算什么，你竟对他怀念不忘？ 人子算什么，你竟对他眷顾周详？

text_en: Yet you have made them a little lower than God, and crowned them with glory and honor.
text_cn: 竟使他稍微逊于天神， 以尊贵光荣作他冠冕，

text_en: You have given them dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under their feet,
text_cn: 令他统治你手的造化， 将一切放在他的脚下：

text_en: all sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field,
text_cn: 所有的羊和牛， 与野外的走兽，

text_en: the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, whatever passes along the paths of the seas.
text_cn: 天空的飞鸟和海里的鱼类， 及种种游泳于海道的水族。

text_en: O Lord , our Sovereign, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
text_cn: 上主，我们的主！ 你的名号在普世何其美妙！
